recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5690 unless a future work group decision reopens broader W5 source type harmonization or Observation-specific informant semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-5690 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 request about inconsistent patient-entered and patient-reported source handling across Observation, QuestionnaireAnswers, MedicationStatement, and Immunization. The approved resolution was to add informant to W5 under who.source and continue broader consistency tracking in future versions.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 6132, represented in git by 60a24188d814b7e957287a10635f71d61cfc9c78 (#5690 - add informants to w5), which updated old source spreadsheets for Immunization, MedicationStatement, QuestionnaireAnswers, and ClinicalImpression.
additional_context: The current build uses source/fhir.ini to include the FiveWs logical pattern and the relevant resources. Later source evolution renamed or split several DSTU1 elements, but current Immunization.primarySource, Immunization.informationSource, MedicationStatement.informationSource, and QuestionnaireResponse.source map to FiveWs.source. Observation.performer already permits Patient and RelatedPerson, while Observation's FiveWs mapping exception keeps FiveWs.source unmapped rather than conflating performer with informant.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current core source already implements the FHIR-5690 decision through FiveWs.source/who.source and relevant resource mappings.
